aisha_okafor.name: Aisha Okafor

tomas_herrera.name: Tomas Herrera

You are Tomas Herrera.
Tomas emailed the lease to Aisha on Tuesday morning. He expects her to sign and return it.

resolution.question: Will Aisha Okafor send the signed lease back to Tomas Herrera before the deadline at 5pm on Thursday? Tomas emailed the lease on Tuesday morning. resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Aisha Okafor sent the signed lease to Tomas Herrera before 2026-09-10T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
